claim: Memories sits inside Grand Resort Bad Ragaz; chef Sven Wassmer; alpine cuisine.
quote: Sven Wassmer Memories | Grand Resort Bad Ragaz – Alpine cuisine

claim: Memories holds three MICHELIN stars in Bad Ragaz.
quote: Sven Wassmer Memories – Bad Ragaz - a MICHELIN Guide Restaurant

claim: Boutique Hotel Ochsen is in central Bad Ragaz at Bartholoméplatz 4 with 17 rooms blending vintage and modern, an in-house winery, art gallery and Mediterranean-creative restaurant.
quote: Bartholomépl. 4, 7310 Bad Ragaz... 17 rooms across six categories... vintage and modern... attached winery, an art gallery on site, and a bar

claim: Hotel Bellevue Bad Ragaz is a small boutique in a grand old house, cosy with nooks and stylish accessories.
quote: Hotel Bellevue meets all the criteria for the perfect boutique hotel. Housed in a grand old house, it is furnished in a very cosy style with lots of nooks and stylish accessories

claim: Guests highlight Bellevue's unique bohemian atmosphere, friendly service and that it is not overpriced for its quality.
quote: The hotel's unique bohemian atmosphere was highlighted by guests... Unlike many other hotels in Bad Ragaz, the Bellevue is also not overpriced

claim: Hotel Schloss Ragaz is a castle built around 1890 by Conrad Sonderegger (a Swiss Panama Canal engineer) as a summer residence at Schloss-Strasse 1, with antique-furnished rooms, garden pavilions and glamping lodges.
quote: built around 1890 as a lavish summer residence... three types of accommodations: traditionally furnished rooms in the historic castle, bright tranquil rooms in Garden Pavilions surrounded by nature, and comfortable Glamping Lodges

claim: Park Hotel Sonnenhof Vaduz has been a Relais & Châteaux member since 1979, 29 rooms across diverse themes, four-star superior, with award-winning gourmet restaurant Marée and panoramic park grounds.
quote: Member of Relais & Châteaux since 1979... 29 lovingly designed rooms and suites of the four-star superior category... award-winning gourmet restaurant and a private park with panoramic views

claim: Park Hotel Sonnenhof Vaduz is at Mareestrasse 29 above town, with spa and pool, and Marée restaurant in the Eagle's Nest run by Hubertus Real.
quote: Mareestrasse 29 (postal code FL 9490)... positioned elevated above the town... Spa facilities with swimming pool

claim: Hotel Weiss Kreuz in Malans has just four double rooms at Dorfplatz 1, CHF 220 weekday / CHF 260 weekend, with breakfast and Nespresso machine in each room.
quote: 4 double rooms... Dorfplatz 1, 7208 Malans... Weekday double: CHF 220, Weekend/holiday double: CHF 260... complimentary breakfast and a Nespresso machine

claim: GaultMillau highlights Weiss Kreuz as a renovated village-square hotel-restaurant in a Bündner wine village with both architectural and culinary impact.
quote: Das gekonnt renovierte «Weiss Kreuz» am Dorfplatz setzt im Bündner Dorf nicht nur architektonische, sondern auch kulinarische Akzente

claim: Schlaf-Fass Maienfeld is a converted 8,000-litre wine barrel sleeping up to 4 guests on the Hermann family farm at the foot of Falknis above Maienfeld, with WC and sink 40 m away in an annex.
quote: 8,000-litre wine barrels... up to 4 people... Hermann family's farm estate... toilets and sinks are 40 meters away in an annex building

claim: The Schlaf-Fass is steps from Heidi Village, Heidi Fountain and the Heidi Alp.
quote: located just a few minutes from the world-famous Heidi Village and in walking distance of the Heidi Fountain and Heidi Alp

claim: Berghotel Gaffia at Pizol is at 1,750 m above sea level with 9 cozy double and family rooms and a mountain-hut feel.
quote: 1,750 meters above sea level... 9 cozy double rooms and family rooms with 4- and 6-bed capacities

claim: Bad Ragaz to Vaduz is 19.3 km, about 13 minutes driving.
quote: the driving distance between Bad Ragaz, Switzerland and Vaduz, Liechtenstein is 19.3 km, taking approximately 13 minutes

claim: Bad Ragaz lies about 4 km from the Pizol ski resort, roughly 5 minutes by car or post-bus.
quote: Bad Ragaz is approximately 4 km from the Pizol ski resort center. Bad Ragaz can be reached by car or post bus in just 5 minutes

claim: Bad Ragaz to Malans is about 13 km; the bus takes 26 minutes.
quote: The distance between Bad Ragaz and Malans is 8 miles (approximately 12.9 kilometers)... bus from Bad Ragaz to Malans takes 26 minutes

claim: Marée at Park Hotel Sonnenhof is Hubertus Real's Michelin-starred panorama restaurant; Marée holds 16 Gault Millau points.
quote: The Marée restaurant has been awarded 16 points by the Gault Millau guide
